fields.label: Hero Description
fields.name: hero_desc
fields.default_value: From varicose veins to complex aortic aneurysms — precision care for the arteries, veins and lymphatics that keep you moving. Trained in both open and endovascular technique, chosen because the vessel decides, not the surgeon.

fields.label: About Section Title
fields.name: about_section_title

fields.label: About Section Description
fields.name: about_section_desc
fields.default_value: Dr. S Srikanth Raju is a Senior Consultant Vascular & Endovascular Surgeon and Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals, Hitec City. With 16+ years of experience, he is one of India's few vascular surgeons trained in both open and endovascular procedures.
